integrity: The proof is reconstructed in RESULT.md; the exact checker supports but does not establish the infinite theorem. No outside validation or proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact cubical Hausdorff distance and bent-only farthest-point classification are proved only for even Boolean dimensions m>=2. The full Walsh threshold projection formula holds for all m>=2 and arbitrary real received vectors. Older equivalent Euclidean results are a historical priority risk; the classical Hadamard crosspolytope and bent-function results are credited.
title: Exact Euclidean decoding geometry of first-order Reed–Muller codeword polytopes
